summary: Stage the macOS Fractal rename in the launchd domain that actually owns the legacy daemon, including headless user-domain hosts.

schema.detail: Uses the existing migration journal launchd_domain field; no storage schema change.

rules.detail: Home Manager staging and --stage-fractal share migration domain discovery. Missing, ambiguous and split ownership fail closed before staging mutations. Home Manager refuses a configured domain change during the rename and retains staged session properties.

compatibility.detail: Completed migration guards use the recorded domain. Journals without launchd_domain refuse with the existing typed recovery error. Fresh completed installations without a journal retain their existing guard behavior. General lifecycle and app-installer staging remain outside this support.

downtime.detail: Staging never starts, stops or loads jobs; host cutover remains separate.

manual.detail: Keep Home Manager agent domains aligned with the loaded legacy daemon; inspect with fractal migrate launchd-domain before staging. Do not change domains during the rename.

recovery.detail: No migration or activation is performed by this update. Existing host migration rollback remains journal-bound.
